title: Giriraj Maharaj ka Annakut
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing

scenes.prompt: Close-up portrait of the sacred Govardhan hill Giriraj Maharaj shrine: a dark stone Giriraj shila decorated with marigold garlands, tulsi leaves and a golden crown, glowing diyas around it, centred in the middle of the frame, warm festive light
scenes.tts: गिरिराज महाराज का अन्नकूट क्यों करते हैं?
scenes.sub: Giriraj Maharaj ka Annakut kyun karte hain?
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the shila stays still and serene, the diya flames flicker softly, a few marigold petals drift in the background

scenes.prompt: A grand Annakut: a mountain of rice, sweets, puris and many vegetable dishes arranged in brass vessels in front of a decorated Giriraj shrine, marigold garlands and lit clay diyas, temple courtyard, warm golden light
scenes.tts: अन्नकूट यानी अन्न का पर्वत, जो गिरिराज जी को अर्पित होता है।
scenes.sub: Annakut yaani ann ka parvat, jo Giriraj ji ko arpit hota hai.
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly, thin steam rises slowly from the dishes and the light glows warmly

scenes.prompt: Blue-skinned little Lord Krishna with a peacock feather crown, gentle smile, lifting the green Govardhan hill on the little finger of his left hand, villagers of Gokul and white cows sheltered beneath it, golden light inside, peaceful devotional mood
scenes.tts: कथा है कि कृष्ण जी ने गोवर्धन उठाकर ब्रजवासियों की रक्षा की।
scenes.sub: Katha hai ki Krishna ji ne Govardhan uthakar Brajwasiyon ki raksha ki.
scenes.animate: gentle rain falls softly at the edges, the golden light glows, the faces stay still and serene

scenes.prompt: White cows decorated with colourful garlands and painted horns standing in a village courtyard, a woman offering them fodder and applying a tilak, marigold flowers, morning golden light
scenes.tts: इस दिन गौ माता की भी पूजा की जाती है।
scenes.sub: Is din Gau Mata ki bhi pooja ki jaati hai.

scenes.prompt: Folded hands in front of a glowing diya and the Giriraj shila with flowers, soft golden glow, devotional peaceful mood
scenes.tts: संदेश यही है: प्रकृति और अन्न के लिए कृतज्ञ रहें।
scenes.sub: Sandesh yahi hai: prakriti aur ann ke liye kritagya rahein.

scenes.tts: जय गिरिराज! लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें। शाम को बाबा श्याम के दर्शन। जय गिरिराज महाराज!
scenes.sub: Jai Giriraj! Like, Share, Subscribe karein. Shaam ko Baba Shyam ke darshan. Jai Giriraj Maharaj!
